findings: All 24 crops retain a consistent local keyboard neighborhood and no crop-to-label permutation is visible.
Cable, foreign-object, and tool variants visibly affect the target neighborhood in the declared direction.
Compression, defocus, glare, and motion-blur rows are intentionally ABSTAIN quality failures even when geometric safe-overlap is zero.

Keyboard G is not globally inverted on training: its local AUC is 0.9625651041666666; its negative strict margin comes from a high-scoring clear cool-sensor outlier and a low-scoring low-key cable-rubber outlier.
limitations: The review covers 24 neutral-appearance rows from two training scenes for keyboard G, not the full corpus.
This simulated human review assesses visible crop and label coherence only; it does not qualify rendering realism, physical deployment, or a successor model.
